text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper focuses on optimizing agricultural intensity allocation to balance food production and biodiversity outcomes at the national scale for France. While it involves spatially explicit modeling of agricultural intensity and evaluates multiple scenarios, its primary focus is on agricultural intensity allocation and biodiversity-food production trade-offs rather than on land use/land cover (LULC) prediction or simulation. There is no indication that the study predicts or simulates future LULC changes or produces mapped LULC projections. The bird community and biodiversity aspects are ecological indicators related to agriculture but not LULC per se. Therefore, it does not meet the core inclusion criteria for national-scale LULC prediction studies.)
